# Region Sjælland — Sjælland

This composite page covers **Region Sjælland**, the regional administrative and healthcare organization, and **Sjælland**, the geographic location and statistical region. While distinct in definition—one being an institutional entity and the other a territorial subdivision of [[danmark|Danmark]]—they are deeply intertwined in national healthcare quality reporting, particularly within the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]]. The organization operates within the geographic boundaries of the location, managing hospitals and healthcare clusters that generate the regional data analyzed in national clinical indicator reports.

## Geographic and Organizational Scope
The geographic region of Sjælland contains several key hospitals, including [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]], [[holbaek|Holbæk]], [[nykoebing-falster|Nykøbing Falster]], [[naestved-sygehus|Næstved]], [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koenge|Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge]], [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-roskilde|Sjællands Universitetshospital Roskilde]], and [[slagelse-sygehus|Slagelse]] [^src23]. As a territorial subdivision, it is one of the five Danish regions analyzed at the regional level in national reports [^src32]. The organization, Region Sjælland, contributes data to the national atrial fibrillation database [^src2] and oversees local healthcare clusters such as [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]], [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]], and [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] [^src34]. Additionally, private [[praktiserende-kardiologer|Praktiserende kardiologer]] operate within the region [^src17]. For laboratory testing, the region primarily utilizes the [[npu04998-p-creatinin|NPU04998]] code for p-creatinine measurements, a practice shared with [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src11].

## Epidemiological and Clinical Performance
The incidence of [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]] in the region aligns with national trends, with a national incidence of 3.3 per 1,000 inhabitants [^src2], while the specific prevalence in Region Sjælland reached 27.1 per 1,000 inhabitants in 2024/2025 [^src16]. Mortality rates across the regions varied between 7.4% and 7.9% [^src31]. 

When evaluating clinical quality indicators, the region shows mixed performance:
- **Indikator 1**: The result for Sjælland for the period 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 was 90.6% [^src19]. At the regional level, the proportion varied between 91–93%, meaning the standard was met in all regions for this specific metric [^src5].
- **[[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]**: In the 2022–2023 period, 75.9% of newly diagnosed patients met the indicator [^src20], improving slightly to 78.0% in the subsequent period [^src6]. However, development remains stagnant compared to the positive trends seen in Region Hovedstaden [^src37].
- **[[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]**: No regions, including Sjælland, meet the standard for this indicator, with regional proportions varying between 71% and 82% [^src21].
- **[[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]]**: Region Sjælland fails to meet the 92–94% standard [^src1]. Furthermore, no healthcare clusters in the eastern Danish regions meet the [[standard-80-percent|Standard: ≥80 %]] [^src36].
- **[[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]**: The region struggles with the incidence of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|ischemic stroke]]. The incidence was 1.0% in 2023 [^src1] and 0.9% in 2024 [^src36], failing the strict >0.8% standard [^src12]. The national incidence among prevalent patients is 0.8% [^src12]. Consequently, Sjælland and Region Hovedstaden remain above the national development target, unlike [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src12].

## Anticoagulation and Stroke Outcomes
Clinical practice regarding [[antikoagulationsbehandling|anticoagulation treatment]] reveals that 1,221 patients in Region Sjælland were started on treatment within four months prior to their diagnosis, representing 50.5% of all patients receiving this therapy [^src14]. Among patients admitted with an ischemic stroke or stroke of unknown type, 117 patients (59.1%) in the region had redeemed an oral anticoagulation prescription within 100 days before admission [^src14]. Despite these interventions, 49 out of 3,566 newly diagnosed patients (1.4%) developed an ischemic stroke within one year [^src14].

## Data Quality and Internal Investigations
A significant point of contention arose regarding **[[indikator-8|Indikator 8]]** in the 2023/2024 reporting period. Region Sjælland recorded the lowest proportion among all regions at 4.3% [^src13]. The organization formally disputed these findings, assessing that the results do not align with clinical reality [^src18]. In response, Region Sjælland launched an internal investigation to identify potential registration and data flow errors within their own systems [^src18].
